underlying_release: libxml2 2.15.4 and PHP 8.5.12 ext/dom Dom\XMLDocument::createFromString (AFL++ overlay, source build); Ubuntu PHP 8.5.4 with libxml 2.15.2 via php8.5-xml (Xdebug coverage image)
coverage_limit: Xdebug line coverage sees only simplesamlphp/xml-common PHP lines (DOMDocumentFactory and the Assert classes it calls) and is reported separately; simplesamlphp/assert and webmozart/assert lines are dependencies. AFL++ feedback comes from the native overlay: libxml2 2.15.4 parser.c, parserInternals.c and SAX2.c plus PHP 8.5.12 ext/dom/xml_document.c and document.c, instrumented through an allowlist while the same harness runs; libxml2 tree/XPath code, the other ext/dom sources (namespace_compat.c included), ext/libxml and the interpreted PHP code add no AFL++ tuples. simplesamlphp/xml-common is a Dom\XMLDocument::createFromString loader (libxml2 family, shared with veewee/xml and saloonphp/xml-wrangler's DOM step); its own lines are visible only in the Xdebug report. The pinned base image does not bundle php-fuzzer; replay is per case.
coverage: Xdebug executed line coverage in simplesamlphp/xml-common v3.0.8 PHP source while DOMDocumentFactory::fromString loads the valid XML; AFL++ feedback comes from the allowlisted libxml2 XML parser and PHP ext/dom Dom\XMLDocument loading sources in the native overlay
api: SimpleSAML\XML\DOMDocumentFactory::fromString(string $xml) with its default options (LIBXML_COMPACT | LIBXML_NONET | LIBXML_NSCLEAN | LIBXML_NO_XXE): rejects whitespace-only input and DOCTYPE markup, loads the string with Dom\XMLDocument::createFromString and returns the Dom\XMLDocument, walked namespace-aware
